chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Abi Basir, who said:

I entered upon Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام on a Friday, and I had already performed the Friday prayer and the 'asr prayer. I found that he had engaged in intercourse — meaning from al-bah, that is, he had had relations. He came out to me wrapped in his cloak, then called his maidservant and instructed her to place water for him to pour over himself. So I said to him, "May Allah set you right, have you not performed ghusl?" He said, "I have not yet performed ghusl, nor have I prayed." I said to him, "I have performed al-zuhr and al-'asr together." He said, "There is no harm, because it is not impossible that he عليه السلام only delayed al-zuhr from the time of zawal due to an excuse he had. It only becomes obligatory at zawal when no preventing obstacle from among the obstacles is present. And this also indicates the permissibility of advancing the nawafil."

key_terms.ٱلزَّوَالِ: the sun’s decline from the meridian, marking the start of noon prayer time
key_terms.ٱلْجُمُعَةَ: Friday prayer / the day of Friday in the legal discussion

ai.seo_question: Can the nawafil on Friday be performed before zawal, and may al-zuhr be delayed due to an excuse?
ai.summary: This report discusses the timing of salat on Friday and indicates that delaying al-zuhr from the time of zawal may occur due to an excuse. It also supports the permissibility of performing the nawafil of Friday before zawal.
